mapper.select: SELECT fr.REPORT_ID as reportId, fr.REPORT_CODE as reportCode, fr.REPORT_NAME as reportName, fr.REPORT_TYPE as reportType, fr.REPORT_PERIOD as reportPeriod, fr.REPORT_DATA as reportData, fr.REPORT_STATUS as reportStatus, fr.GENERATE_TIME as generateTime, fr.BOOK_ID as bookId, fr.TENANT_ID as tenantId, fr.VERSION as version, fr.CREATE_TIME as createTime, fr.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, s1.STAFFNAME as creatorName, s2.STAFFNAME as updaterName FROM T_FINANCIAL_REPORT fr LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF s1 ON fr.CREATOR = s1.STAFFID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF s2 ON fr.UPDATER = s2.STAFFID WHERE fr.REPORT_ID = #{reportId} AND fr.IS_DELETED = 0
